scope: GNU x86_64 type-only assembly probes; no engine build, no native execution, temporary append-only header overlay.
probe_source:
#include "SurgeSynthesizer.h"
#include "ConditionerEffect.h"
#include "GraphicEQ11BandEffect.h"
#include "ParametricEQ3BandEffect.h"

sizeof(SurgeStorage),
alignof(SurgeStorage),
sizeof(SurgeSynthesizer),

sizeof(ParametricEQ3BandEffect),

__builtin_offsetof(SurgeStorage,table_dB),

__builtin_offsetof(SurgeStorage,dsamplerate),
__builtin_offsetof(SurgeStorage,dsamplerate_inv),

sizeof(SurgeStorage::noiseRng),
__builtin_offsetof(SurgeSynthesizer,storage),
__builtin_offsetof(SurgeSynthesizer,FX),
__builtin_offsetof(SurgeSynthesizer,amp),
__builtin_offsetof(SurgeSynthesizer,audio_processing_active),
__builtin_offsetof(ConditionerEffect,band1),
__builtin_offsetof(ConditionerEffect,ef),
__builtin_offsetof(ConditionerEffect,a_rate),

__builtin_offsetof(ConditionerEffect,delayed),

__builtin_offsetof(ConditionerEffect,filtered_lamax),
__builtin_offsetof(ConditionerEffect,gain),

notes: No engine binary was rebuilt or executed.
GNU offsetof on these non-standard-layout classes is conditionally supported; diagnostics were retained, not suppressed.

An initial assembly parser selected past the data array and failed its count assertion. Parsing was corrected to the contiguous numeric .quad array without recompilation; all three probes compiled successfully.
Only the GNU x86_64 layout was examined; no cross-platform ABI or timing claim.
overlay_changes: Moved the existing coefficientTableGeneration declaration from before samplerate to the end of SurgeStorage data members.
Moved Conditioner coefficient cache fields after original gain member.
Moved EQ3 and EQ11 coefficient cache fields after their original bi members.
validation_after_application: Identical to previously compiled temporary overlay; coordinator owns full native rebuild and audio/CPU validation.
